notes: Position this as the decision frame for the full deck: enter now, but with focus and sequencing rather than a broad national bet. Emphasize urgency from market growth and the window before consolidation hardens channel and brand positions. Expect the question: what does focused entry mean in cities, partners, and launch waves?
title: A focused India entry gives a new OEM the best path to capture electric two-wheeler growth before the market consolidates
subtitle: Strategy deck recommending a premium-urban launch, local partnerships, and phased scale-up so a differentiated entrant can secure early share in India’s large, fast-growing electric two-wheeler category without taking national mass-market risk
